payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about various baseline experiments conducted in the context of speech translation (ST) and multi-task learning, including encoder and decoder pre-training methods.

claims.text: Pre-training baselines include encoder pre-training from an ASR model, decoder pre-training from an MT model, and encoder-decoder pre-training.
Multi-task baselines consist of one-to-many, many-to-one, and many-to-many settings.
The vanilla ST baseline consists of only a speech encoder and a decoder.
Several competitive baselines were reproduced for fair comparison due to different data pre-processing methods.
